title: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
summary: Find the largest sum of a nonempty consecutive segment in a circular array.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Find the largest sum of a nonempty consecutive segment in a circular array. A segment may cross from the last element to the first, but it cannot use any position more than once.

examples.explanation: The last and first values are adjacent around the circle.
The best nonempty choice is the single −2.
Taking the whole array is optimal.

hints: Conceptual: A wrapping segment leaves one ordinary gap.
Directional: Compute both the largest ordinary sum and the smallest ordinary sum.
Implementation: Compare the best ordinary segment with total minus the smallest segment. When all values are negative, keep the best nonempty ordinary segment.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
